desc:
Welcome to SpongeBob Simulator!

Dive into an epic SpongeBob adventure in Bikini Bottom with all of your favorite characters, settings, and storylines!
👍 Leave a like and favorite for SpongeBob Simulator Updates!
🧽 Morph into iconic SpongeBob characters!
😺 Collect unique and adorable buddies - snails, jellyfish, mini-characters from your favorite episodes, and more!
🌴 Explore and visit iconic locations across Bikini Bottom!
🗝️ Team up and defeat bosses and crack large treasure chests!

Available for PC, Xbox, PS5, Tablet, and Mobile!
